title: Episode About the Brass Near Jaal Piloo Forest

blocks.text: Kapura sends word away from the Guru, distancing himself and helping broadcast the trail to hostile powers, while the narrative bends toward the events that will culminate in Muktsar. (1–3)
The birar country debates what should be done, and the Guru continues to move with only those companions willing to bind themselves to the path through hardship. (4–5)

Thus the page serves as the threshold into Muktsar: treachery behind, pursuit behind that, and the next decisive clash beginning to gather shape. Muktsar is no abrupt jump but the ripening of this long retreat. (overall)
